gloss: feudal lord; domain lord; daimyō of a han

definitions.gloss: feudal lord; domain lord; daimyō of a han
definitions.explanation: The lord who governed a han (feudal domain) during the Edo period of Japan. Each han was a semi-autonomous territory granted by the shogun.

examples.japanese: {藩主|はんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: The feudal lord returned to the castle.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{藩主|はんしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奨励|しょうれい}→奨励：12213_shourei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The lord of this domain promoted scholarship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幕末|ばくまつ}→幕末：12531_bakumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{藩主|はんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{藩政改革|はんせいかいかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んだ→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the Edo period, many feudal lords undertook reforms of their domain's governance.

notes:
A term from the Edo period (1603–1868) referring to the ruler of a ⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧ (feudal domain). The {藩主|はんしゅ} held authority over governance, taxation, and military forces within the domain, but owed loyalty to the ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧ (shogun) in Edo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {藩主|はんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧ — the lord's order
- ⟦{初代|しょだい}→初代：11778_shodai⟧{藩主|はんしゅ} — the first lord (founder of the domain)
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{藩主|はんしゅ} — the last lord (before abolition of domains)
- {藩主|はんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{代|か}わる→代わる：11718_kawaru⟧ — the lord changes (succession)
